def: A learned machine-translation metric: a model built on a pretrained cross-lingual encoder reads the source, the translation and a reference translation and predicts a human quality score.
practice: Trained on human judgments such as Direct Assessments and MQM annotations; Rei et al. (2020) reported state-of-the-art correlation with humans on the WMT 2019 metrics task, so prefer it to BLEU for translation.
